body.statement:
Assume the declared relative-interior, tangent-image, local-family affine-hull, multinomial-interior, base-convergence, compact local-expansion, effective moving-remainder, and effective moving-offset-encoding conditions.  Suppose \(c_n\to c\in\mathcal K_0\).  For a rational compact polytope \(C\), define
\[
 d_n(C)=\sup_{u\in C}\left\|\sqrt n\{p_n(u)-p_n(0)\}-Bu\right\|_2,
 \quad
 \delta_n(C)=\max_j\sup_{u\in C}|e_{n,j}(u)|,
\]
choose \(\widehat c_n\in\mathcal K_0\cap\mathbb Q^{|\mathcal J_0^{\mathrm{act}}|}\) with \(\|\widehat c_n-c_n\|_\infty\leq\xi_n\), and put \(\chi_n(C)=d_n(C)+\delta_n(C)+\xi_n\).  Given a supplied effective rational upper enclosure \(\overline\chi_n(C)\geq\chi_n(C)\) with \(\overline\chi_n(C)\to0\), the unconditional lemma \(\mathrm{lem:moving\mbox{-}offset\mbox{-}carter\mbox{-}geometry}\) transfers any supplied Gaussian rule for \(\mathfrak G_0(\widehat c_n)\) to \(C\), with additive coverage-deficit and normalized separated-risk charge
\[
 \Delta_n(C)=C_{2/\kappa}\frac{|\mathcal J|\log|\mathcal J|}{\sqrt n}
 +\operatorname{Err}_{\Sigma,n}(C)
 +(H_C+2A_0)\overline\chi_n(C),
\]
where
\[
 A_0=\sum_{j\in\mathcal J_0^{\mathrm{act}}}
 \frac{2}{\sqrt{2\pi}\{a_j'\Sigma_0a_j\}^{1/2}}.
\]
If the affirmative conclusion specified in \(\mathrm{oeq:effective\mbox{-}compatible\mbox{-}density}\), or a separately proved sufficient compatibility package yielding its displayed finite-library bounds, is available, then \(\operatorname{CertGluePFL}\) supplies such Gaussian rules and the transferred compact rule is replayable.  Its total certified excess is at most \(\Delta_n(C)\) plus the outward chart, tail, integration, rounding, and exact-repair entries, and these terms can be scheduled to vanish.  This conditional construction uses \(\widehat c_n\), not the unknown limit \(c\), and makes no honesty or risk claim outside \(C\).
body.justification: The theorem now gives a determinate compact moving-offset rule using computable rational approximations to the observed offset.
body.gap: It does not extend compact control to all unbounded finite-sample truth regions.
body.consumer: Drifting capacity and endpoint-program faces receive an explicit boundary and offset charge.
body.proof_tex:
\textbf{Technique: compatible affine-offset lifting followed by the unconditional Carter--geometry lemma and a conditional certificate invocation.}
Let \(A_\Psi\) have rows \(\alpha_j'\), \(j\in\mathcal J_0^{\mathrm{act}}\).  Since every active cut has \(\psi_j(p_0)=0\),
\[
 c_n=A_\Psi\sqrt n\{p_n(0)-p_0\}.
 \tag{15}
\]
The local-family affine-hull condition places the vector after \(A_\Psi\) in \(L_{\mathrm{ASC}}=\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\).  The definition of \(\mathcal K_0\) therefore yields
\[
 c_n\in\mathcal K_0\qquad\text{for every }n.
 \tag{16}
\]
The effective offset encoding returns the rational \(\widehat c_n\) in the statement.  For every active facet, the exact moving-slack identity gives
\[
 \zeta_{n,j}(u)-(\widehat c_{n,j}+a_j'u)
 =(c_{n,j}-\widehat c_{n,j})+e_{n,j}(u),
 \tag{17}
\]
and consequently
\[
 \max_j\sup_{u\in C}
 |\zeta_{n,j}(u)-(\widehat c_{n,j}+a_j'u)|
 \leq\delta_n(C)+\xi_n\leq\overline\chi_n(C).
 \tag{18}
\]

We verify that the Gaussian object used conditionally is lawful.  Rational linear algebra applied to the rational image description of \(\mathcal K_0\) gives a rational \(z_n\in L_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) with \(A_\Psi z_n=\widehat c_n\).  Relative interiority implies that, for every fixed \(u\),
\[
 p_0+t(z_n+Bu)\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}
 \quad\text{for all sufficiently small }t>0.
 \tag{19}
\]
Indeed, in a relative-facet representation \(Eq=e\), \(F_iq\leq f_i\), one has \(E(z_n+Bu)=0\), while every slack \(f_i-F_ip_0\) is positive; choosing \(t\) below the minimum of the finitely many positive ratios proves (19).  Every feasible optimal branch completion at (19) has active signs
\[
 \operatorname{sgn}\{\alpha_j'(z_n+Bu)\}
 =\operatorname{sgn}(\widehat c_{n,j}+a_j'u),
 \tag{20}
\]
with equality assigned to every incident completion.  Hence the offset semantic cells cover \(\mathbb R^d\).

If the active list is nonempty, choose a strict chamber direction \(y\) of the finite homogeneous arrangement.  Along \(ty\), every fixed offset in (20) is dominated by its nonzero homogeneous slack.  For each rival component there is a nonzero rational row \(a' g\leq b\) and constants \(\gamma>0\), \(C<\infty\) such that its gap at \(ty\) is at least \(t\gamma-C\).  For every point \(g\) in that rival component, Cauchy--Schwarz in the \(\Sigma_0\) metric gives
\[
 t\gamma-C\leq a'(ty-g)
 \leq\|a\|_{\Sigma_0}\|ty-g\|_{\Sigma_0^{-1}}.
 \tag{21}
\]
The denominator is positive because \(a\neq0\) and \(\Sigma_0\succ0\).  The finite minimum of (21) exceeds \(r_0\) for sufficiently large \(t\), proving a nonempty separated domain.  If there are no active cuts, \(\mathrm{prop:tangent\mbox{-}fan\mbox{-}global\mbox{-}cover}\) gives one global semantic label and the conclusion is immediate.  Positivity of \(p_0\) and full column rank of \(B\) give \(\Sigma_0\succ0\); all cell and covariance data are rational.  Thus \(\mathfrak G_0(\widehat c_n)\in\mathfrak E\).

Now supply an arbitrary Gaussian rule on this offset experiment.  Equations (17)--(18), Carter's positive-cell bound, and the score-normal covariance enclosure meet every hypothesis of \(\mathrm{lem:moving\mbox{-}offset\mbox{-}carter\mbox{-}geometry}\).  That unconditional lemma gives the additive charge
\[
 \Delta_n(C)=C_{2/\kappa}\frac{|\mathcal J|\log|\mathcal J|}{\sqrt n}
 +\operatorname{Err}_{\Sigma,n}(C)
 +(H_C+2A_0)\overline\chi_n(C).
 \tag{22}
\]
No compatibility-density assertion is used in (15)--(22).

For the final replayability clause, assume explicitly the affirmative construction and bounds stated in \(\mathrm{oeq:effective\mbox{-}compatible\mbox{-}density}\), or a separately proved package supplying the same finite-library inequalities.  The conditional \(\mathrm{thm:certglue\mbox{-}termination}\) applied to \(\mathfrak G_0(\widehat c_n)\) then returns a finite Gaussian rule, its atomic dual, and outward chart, tail, quadrature, rounding, and repair entries.  Apply the parameter-independent forward Carter kernel to that rule.  The triangle inequality and (22) bound both the coverage deficit and the normalized separated-risk excess by \(\Delta_n(C)\) plus those nonnegative outward entries.

The supplied enclosure tends to zero, so the linear term in (22) vanishes; the Carter term \(C_{2/\kappa}|\mathcal J|\log|\mathcal J|/\sqrt n\) vanishes, and the covariance term vanishes by the compact covariance lemma.  Under the stated affirmative conditional premise, request certificate, tail, integration, rounding, and repair accuracies successively below \(1/n\).  Their finite searches terminate by the premise and by the CertGlue theorem, so every remaining outward entry tends to zero.  This proves the conditional replayable conclusion.  Every infimum and supremum used in the transfer is restricted to \(C\); nothing in the argument asserts honesty or risk control on the exterior unbounded regions.
